title: Instrole Platform Overview
desc: Complete wearable gait diagnostics platform with foot pressure insoles and mobile analytical dashboard.

title: Oreejoy Team & Research Lab
desc: The research team at Intelligent Human-Computer Interaction Lab working on bio-sensing technology.

title: Instrole Lacing Pod Attachment
desc: A single blue running shoe fitted with the sleek, white and peach-toned Instrole electronic pod clipped securely over the laces. Designed for seamless tracking, this pod captures real-time motion and pressure data without interfering with natural running form.

title: Dual Instrole Pod Setup
desc: A pair of blue athletic shoes featuring synchronized Instrole lace pods. Positioned front and center on each shoe, these compact sensor modules monitor biomechanical metrics during workouts and gait assessments.

title: Instrole Heel Clip Module
desc: A studio view of athletic shoes equipped with blue Instrole heel-mounted electronics modules. This ergonomic placement ensures a firm, non-slip attachment to measure heel strike dynamics and footwear movement accurately.

title: Instrole Sensor Insole & Heel Clip Display
desc: A clear breakdown showing an Instrole smart sensor insole alongside a running shoe fitted with the heel-clip module. The transparent base panel highlights how the flexible pressure insert pairs with the main tracking unit.

title: Flexible Pressure Sensor Matrix Layer
desc: A close-up view of the underside of the flexible sensor insole, revealing the ribbon connector extending from the soft base. This integrated wiring safely feeds high-density pressure data from the footbed to the processing pod.

title: Ergonomic Cushioning Layer
desc: Demonstrating the dual-layer construction of the Instrole flexible insert, featuring a soft blue foam surface designed for user comfort and impact absorption during dynamic activities.

title: Instrole Flexible Insole Assembly
desc: A hands-on view showing the top black textile finish of the flexible Instrole insert along with its protective cable sleeve, highlighting the quality packaging and durable material layering.

title: Showcasing Instrole to Dr. L.N. Dorairajan, Director of AIIMS Rajkot
desc: An Oreejoy representative presents Instrole—an instrumented smart insole system developed in collaboration with IIT Gandhinagar—to Dr. L.N. Dorairajan, Director of AIIMS Rajkot, at the IRACS Lab. The session highlights accessible, affordable gait assessment and objective mobility monitoring for clinical and neurological care.

title: Healthcare Technologies Meeting with Clinical Educators
desc: Oreejoy MedTech hosts distinguished physiotherapy educators and clinicians from Marwadi University, Shree KK Sheth Physiotherapy College (Rajkot), Shree Aryatej Institute of Physiotherapy (Morbi), and IIPHG at IIT Gandhinagar. The presentation details PTreadX gait rehabilitation solutions and energy expenditure analysis to bridge academic research with real-world clinical workflows.

title: Prof. Uttama Lahiri at Boeing BUILD 5.0
desc: Prof. Uttama Lahiri presents the underlying science behind INSTROLE during the Boeing BUILD 5.0 event at IIT Gandhinagar. The talk demonstrates how foot imprints reveal critical biometric profiles—including healthy, flat-foot, pre-fall, Parkinsonian, and diabetic foot pressure signatures—enabling early detection of foot and gait disorders in affordable clinical settings.
